description: SSD1306 0.96" 128x64 OLED on I2C1 (PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA, 400 kHz): library init with charge pump, text + frame counter + progress bar + circle redrawn every 200 ms
expect:
72 MHz. I2C1 PB6/PB7 AF open drain, 400 kHz fast mode (DUTY 2, CCR 30); the OLED module has its own 4.7 kOhm pull-ups and 3.3 V regulator. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Prints 'SSD1306 OLED demo
', waits 100 ms, probes 0x3C with HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady (2 trials): HAL_BUSY -> 'I2C bus busy: SDA/SCL stuck low (pull-ups?)
' and stops; no ACK (no module, module jumper at 0x3D, VCC not wired) -> 'SSD1306 not found at 0x3C (no ACK)
' and stops. Otherwise sends the library init sequence (AEh, D5h 80h, A8h 3Fh, D3h 00h, 40h, 8Dh 14h, 20h 00h, A1h, C8h, DAh 12h, 81h CFh, D9h F1h, DBh 40h, A4h, A6h, 2Eh, AFh) with control byte 00h and prints 'SSD1306 at 0x3C ready
'. Every 200 ms (deadline based) frame N = 1, 2, ...: window 21h 0..127 / 22h 0..7, then the 1024-byte GDDRAM image with control byte 40h (about 23 ms on the bus): border rectangle (0,0)-(127,63), 'Hello, ohmlet!' at (8,6), 'SSD1306 128x64' at (8,18), 'frame N' at (8,30) in a 5x7 font (6 px advance), progress bar outline (8,44)-(99,53) filled from x = 10 by (N mod 100)*88/99 px, circle r = 9 at (113,48). Every 5th frame 'frame N
' on USART1. A failed transfer prints 'I2C error <HAL error code>
' and stops.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
no OLED on this bench: the probe of 0x3C is not acknowledged (the drawing loop is covered by tests/devices/displays-firmware.test.ts)

boot.USART1:
SSD1306 OLED demo
SSD1306 not found at 0x3C (no ACK)
